SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.username AS userAccount, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.product_price AS productPrice, oi.subtotal AS subtotal, o.status AS orderStatus, o.create_time AS createTime FROM order_item oi JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id
oi.product_id = #{productId}
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS totalAmount FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.product_id = #{productId}
